sources.title: Visa Burkina: conditions of entry
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate-General of National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The live national Visa Burkina portal carries the Ministry of Security / National Police copyright and presents official entry conditions. It gives a generic foreigner rule expressly qualified by exemption, not an exemption roster.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Un visa d’entrée ou un accord de visa ou un permis ou titre de séjour sauf exemption.

sources.title: Visa Burkina: electronic visa FAQ
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate-General of National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry-linked Visa Burkina FAQ describes the format and pre-travel delivery of an approved electronic visa. It does not identify any eligible or exempt nationality.
sources.supportingExcerpt: le visa électronique est envoyé, après approbation ministérielle, par e-mail au requérant

sources.title: Visa Burkina applicant visa-configuration endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: The live applicant React bundle calls this endpoint to obtain visa types, nationalities and restricted-country fields. A direct anonymous HTTPS GET replay returned HTTP 401, so no nationality configuration was exposed without authentication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Full authentication is required to access this resource.

sources.title: Government communiqué following United States visa restrictions
sources.publisher: Government Information Service of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Government Information Service communiqué identifies U.S. visa restrictions and reciprocal measures, but does not publish an operational ordinary U.S.-passport route, effective implementation details or treatment of valid visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Communiqué suite à la restriction des visas des Etats-Unis d’Amérique.

Generic portal access is not treated as eligibility or a replacement status.
